basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Review is initially selected. Choose Draft to go back; Publish is disabled.

read-only.title: Read-only progress
read-only.description: Without onChange the steps are a read-only progress indicator: a plain ordered list (no buttons) whose current item has aria-current="step".

styling.title: Styling
styling.description: Completed steps show a check mark on a solid disc, the current one a soft halo, and the connectors fill in as steps complete. --steps-accent-color recolors them, --steps-connector-min-width / --steps-connector-color tune the lines.

StepsProps.value: Value of the current step (controlled; pair with onChange)
StepsProps.defaultValue: Value of the initial current step (uncontrolled)
StepsProps.onChange: Called with the value of the step the user navigates to. Steps only report navigation: validation and workflow transitions belong to the caller
StepsProps.readOnly: Renders the steps as a read-only progress indicator: plain list items without buttons, the current one marked aria-current="step"

StepsItem.value: Unique value of the step, matched against the Steps value
StepsItem.label: Visible label of the step
StepsItem.disabled: Prevents navigating to this step (e.g. a terminal state that is not reached yet)

cssVars.--steps-gap: Space between the steps (row and column gap)
cssVars.--steps-accent-color: Color of the current / completed indicators (defaults to --primary-color)
cssVars.--steps-current-background: Background of the current step's indicator
cssVars.--steps-connector-color: Color of the line joining the upcoming steps (defaults to --border-color)
cssVars.--steps-connector-complete-color: Color of the line after a completed step (defaults to the accent color)
cssVars.--steps-connector-min-width: Minimum length of the line joining two steps

basic.title: Read-only progress
basic.description: Steps come from the items property; earlier steps are complete and the current one has aria-current="step".

navigable.title: Navigable wizard
navigable.description: navigable turns each step into a button. minerva-change is cancelable: the caller validates the transition (accept the terms to leave the first step).

styling.title: Styling
styling.description: CSS variables set the accent color, indicator size and gap; ::part(label) styles the labels.

props.navigable: Renders each step as a button the user can navigate with (default: read-only).

events.minerva-change: The user navigated to a step (detail: { value }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current step.
